programme.title: Otvorena sezona - Zov prirode
programme.desc: Bug i Eliot se zbližavaju sa Dinom i njegovom bandom oposuma, uzbudljivim, ali sumnjivim likovima. Privučeni sjajem televizije, video igara i ukusne nezdrave hrane, ne primećuju šta se zaista dešava.

programme.title: Otvorena sezona - Zov prirode
programme.desc: Eliot spasava Iana iz opasne situacije koju je sam i izazvao, a zahvalni Ian poteže ""Kodeks jelena"" _ drevni kodeks koji nalaže da je sada Ian odgovoran za Eliotovu dobrobit.

programme.title: Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Tokom neobičnog nestanka struje u okrugu Leksington u Londonu, sva svetla i elektronski uređaji se isključuju. Klever istražuje mesto pljačke zlatare, koja je podjednako čudna.

programme.title: Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Jedne noći, golub Alfred bio je svedok otmice hrčka od strane izuzetno sposobnog, brzog i veštog stvorenja. Dok Alfred pokušava da ga prati, stvorenje ga uspavljuje tokom leta jednim jednostavnim pogledom.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing želi da mu se zavrti u glavi na vrtešci, pa ga Pando vrti superbrzo. Bing će ubrzo naučiti da vrtoglavica nije zabavna, a da previše vrtoglavice baš nimalo nije zabavno.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing pravi kućicu od jastuka za kauč, a Koko odlučuje da je to savršen početak igre ""Veliki zli vuk"" sa Sulom i Čarlijem. Bing uživa u ulozi vuka dok mu ne zabrane ulazak u kućicu koju je sam podigao, kad igra prestaje da mu bude zanimljiva.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Dan je topao, i Bing i Flop kupuju sladoled na štapiću od prodavačice Džili. Pre nego što ga pojedu, žaba uskače u Bingov bazen i oni otrčavaju da je spasu. Kada se vrate svom sladoledu, od njega su ostali samo štapići i tanjir lepljive istopljene mase.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Kristinina kornjača nestala je iz ograđenog prostora... Kao da je isparila! Članovi Pets kluba takmiče se u rešavanju ovog slučaja. Uprkos dokazima, istraga nikako ne napreduje: pseće dlake su nađene u kavezu, ali Kristinin pas ne bi mogao da preskoči ogradu. Vrana je nedužna, uprkos perju koje je svuda po bašti. Čak je i mladi mađioničar osumnjičen ni zbog čega. Pets klub je u ćorsokaku... Ali kornjača možda nikad nije ni napustila ograđeni prostor.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Mada obično ne brine o divljim životinjama, Pets klub pomaže Nuru da izleči povređenog ježa kog je našao u svojoj bašti... Pošto životinja slabi, odnose ga kod Žilua, njihovog druga veterinara, koji im saopštava neverovatne vesti: ovaj jež je u stvari... Ženka koja je upravo dobila bebe. Počinje trka protiv vremena i potraga za bebama koje će biti gladne bez svoje mame... Drugari brzo shvataju da je ježa povredio bicikl u parku...

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad u kolevku
programme.desc: Nagon događaja u filmu Mali Šef 2, odraslom poslovnom čoveku Teodoru Templtonu smeštena je pronevera u kompaniji i primoran je da se vrati svom starom ja, Malom Šefu, i živi sa svojim bratom Timom. Ali da bi to izveo, mora da navede Timovu porodicu da mu dopusti da ostane, i ubedi Bebiko da mu vrati njegov stari posao... Koji trenutno obavlja njegova nećaka, beba Tina.

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad u kolevku
programme.desc: Nagon događaja u filmu Mali Šef 2, odraslom poslovnom čoveku Teodoru Templtonu smeštena je pronevera u kompaniji i primoran je da se vrati svom starom ja, Malom Šefu, i živi sa svojim bratom Timom. Ali da bi to izveo, mora da navede Timovu porodicu da mu dopusti da ostane, i ubedi Bebiko da mu vrati njegov stari posao... Koji trenutno obavlja njegova nećaka, beba Tina.

programme.title: Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Golijat, pas strah i trepet u parku, koga se boje sve lutalice, nalazi protivnika jačeg od sebe: stvorenje sa crnim krznom i sjajnim očima koje stoji na zadnjim nogama poput vukodlaka.

programme.title: Barbi Palčica
programme.desc: Barbi predstavlja klasičnu priču o Palčici ispričanu na moderan način. Upoznajte sićušnu devojčicu Palčicu koja živi u harmoniji sa prirodom u magičnom svetu. Zbog hira razmažene devojčice Makene, Palčici i njenim dvoma prijateljima iščupali su cveće i preneli ga u raskošni stan u gradu. Tu saznaju o građevinskim planovima koji prete da unište zemlju. Palčica koristi moć prirode kako bi to sprečila i tako dokazala da čak i najmanja osoba može da napravi velike promene.

programme.title: Barbi u svetu vila
programme.desc: Spremite se za Barbinu vilinsku tajnu, čudesnu avanturu sa Barbi, u kojoj ona otkriva da postoje vile koje žive tajno svuda oko nas! Kada grupa vila iznenada uspe da odvede Kena, Barbine dve drugarice, modne dizajnerke, otkrivaju da su one zapravo vile i da je Ken odveden u obližnji čarobni vilinski svet! Barbi i njena rivalka Rakel kreću sa drugaricama vilama da bi ga vratile na putovanje puno akcije. Na putu se moraju držati jedna druge i naučiti da prava čarolija ne leži samo u vilinskom svetu, već u moći prijateljstva.

programme.title: Barbi - Dodir Čarolije
programme.desc: Barbi i Barbi nalaze misteriozno ždrebe na plaži u Malibuu i ubrzo shvataju da je mali konj zapravo beba Pegaz! Zajedničkim snagama se trude da vrate malu Pegi kući štiteći je od Rokija, fantastičnog Glifa. Na već poznatoj lokaciji u Malibuu Barbi, Barbi i njihovi prijatelji shvataju da se magija zaista može naći svuda oko nas.

programme.title: Džepna Poli
programme.desc: Nakon avanture u Blistavom zalivu, Džepna Poli će osvojene magične kristale pokajt podeliti sa svojim prijateljima i porodicom tako što će i njima dati magične moći. Na taj način će Šani moći da razume i prevodi bilo koji jezik, čak i jezik životinja! A Lila će moći da se pretvori u šta god poželi, od kolibrija do poznatog modnog dizajnera! Uz ove nove moći, male avanture Poli i njenih prijatelja postaće još veće. Šani i Lila će sa svojim novim moćima imati priliku da otkrivaju nove stvari svojim prijateljima!

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Marina saznaje da je Vendi kao mala išla na časove jahanja. To nije pošteno! I Marina želi isto, ali to je nažalost nemoguće. Vendi predlaže da naprave kućnu školu jahanja na drvenom konjiću! Vendi je nadarena učiteljica i vrlo ozbiljno objašnjava sestri kako da brine o "poniju", toliko ozbiljno da biste poverovali da je stvaran. Ali Marina radi ono što ona želi. Vendi se ljuti i slučajno lomi "ponija"! Marina je očajna. Vendi nalazi rešenje: prerušiće se u ponija i ponašaće se kao pravi poni!

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Marina i Vendi se ponose svojom mamom: pravi novinar dolazi da napiše priču o njenoj bašti. Ali kad probaju da joj pomognu, sestre će razbiti saksiju sa cvećem. To je katastrofa za njihovu majku koja misli da njena bašta više ne izgleda skladno. Ona žuri da kupi novu sasksiju i ostavlja Marinu i Vendi same u bašti. Devojčice su rešene da "isprave stvar" na svoj poseban način. Sestre će napraviti pravi baštenski masakr, onako kako samo one umeju. Ding-dong! Pred njihovim vratima je novinar..."

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Dečaci i devojke Veverice su obični klinci. Idu u školu, imaju kućne poslove i domaće zadatke, svađaju se kao porodica i nastupaju na rasprodatim koncertima pred milionima obožavalaca. O, jesmo li pomenuli da su oni međunarodne rok zvezde?

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Kada Teodor pomisli da je pravi superheroj, Alvin i Sajmon će morati dobro da se potrude ne bi li ga ubedili da borbu protiv zločina prepusti profesionalcima.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Kada Teodor pomisli da je pravi superheroj, Alvin i Sajmon će morati dobro da se potrude ne bi li ga ubedili da borbu protiv zločina prepusti profesionalcima.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Kada ekipa Kret gubi moćni mikroprocesorski čip u Nemačkoj, odlučuje da prati hrčke da vidi da li će glodari možda naći čip.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Kad braća Kret naiđu na krdo divljih konja na plaži, Aviva i Koki jedva čekaju da ih vide. Međutim, kad počne oluja, ekipa Kret je primorana da se povuče u Tortugu. Posle oluje, ekipa nalazi ždrebe divljeg konja koje je talas odvojio od krda. Kris i Martin odlučuju da spoje hrčka sa njegovom mamom.

programme.title: Nekada Davno - Predmeti
programme.desc: Nikad dalje od maskenbala, Maestro nam pokazuje hirurške maske koje su koristili radnici u rimskim rudnicima prve godine nove ere, da bi zaštitili pluća od prašine. U srednjem veku, tokom epidemije kuge, smatralo se da maske sa dugim kljunovima štite doktore od "lošeg vazduha". Mnogo kasnije, hirurške maske se pokazuju kao mnogo delotvornije protiv bolesti i virusa poput kovida-19.

programme.title: Nekada Davno - Predmeti
programme.desc: Maestrov sat zvoni: ima sastanak sa agentom Nula-Nula, vođom tajne službe. Jedan od zidova njegove dnevne sobe se pomera i otkriva tajnu bazu... U kojoj se razvijaju različite vrste lepka. Ali Minus i Krasti, neprijateljski agenti, pokušavaju da otmu Maestra dok on priča drugim agentima iz baze o različitim vrstama lepka i načinima na koji rade!

programme.title: Radoznali Džordž
programme.desc: Štaaaaaaa? Majmun nevaljalac? Ali nemojte odmah da pomišljate na najgore! Džordž, pored toga što sjajno zabavlja sve članove svoje porodice, ima i mnogo korisnih informacija o prirodnim naukama na poljima matematike, ali ako dobro paziš, saznaćeš ponešto i iz tehnike. Uz pomoć Džordžove neuništive radoznalosti, na kraju serije i ti ćeš da postaneš mali naučnik, a dlakavi prijatelj ti takođe garantuje i dobro raspoloženje. Ostani sa nama!Štaaaaaaa? Majmun nevaljalac? Ali nemojte odmah da pomišljate na najgore! Džordž, pored toga što sjajno zabavlja sve članove svoje porodise, ima i mnogo korisnih informacija o prirodnim naukama na poljima matematike, ali ako dobro paziš, saznaćeš ponešto i iz tehnike. Uz pomoć Džordžove neuništive radoznalosti, na kraju serije i ti ćeš da postaneš mali naučnik, a dlakavi prijatelj ti takođe garantuje i dobro raspoloženje. Ostani sa nama!

programme.title: Radoznali Džordž
programme.desc: Nakon igranja sa ogromnom maketom železnice gospodina Kvinta, Džordž zaboravlja da zatvori prozor podruma, omogućujući tako veverici Džampiju da se ušunja unutra i sakrije žirove u tunelima. Kada Džordž sutradan nastavi da se igra, uspaničena veverica i sudar sa žirovima izbacuju voz iz šina. Džordž mora nekako ponovo da sklopi maketu pre nego što se gospodin Kvint vrati. Mada Džordž misli da je vetar previše jak za igru, smatra da je ipak vrlo koristan na velikoj farmi vetra, gde je imao priliku da popravlja turbinu pomoću svojih majmunskih veština penjanja.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Dva psa u kraju su se razbolela. Žilu misli da je razlog trovanje hranom. Vlasnica bolesnog psa, Elodi, upozorava Pets klub, koji brzo dolazi na trag čudnoj osobi koja izgleda mrzi pse. Ali to je ipak pogrešan trag. Epidemija se pogoršava, ali Žilu otkriva da su psi otrovani... čokoladom! Hoće li uspeti da nađu razlog ovakvog trovanja?

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Raulov magarac Dijabolo ima čudne nervne napade i rita se bez razloga. Da bi bolje razumeli njegovu situaciju, članovi Pets kluba kreću sa njim u šetnju i saznaju da Dijabolo uopšte nema lošu narav! Pa zašto je ljut bez razloga? Tim će otkriti da je Dijabolo doživeo prelom noge kad je bio mali. Prelom koji nije prirodan! Shvatiće da magarci imaju sjajno pamćenje i nikad ne zaboravljaju ljude koji su im naudili.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Pets klub danas nema posla sa običnim nestankom _ nestala je riba borac Dede. Napustila je svoj akvarijum bez ikakvog objašnjenja. To može da bude samo krađa koju je organizovao Stanislas, tinejdžer čiji hobi je organizovanje borbi ovih lepih riba. Pogrešan trag. Kasnije otkrivaju ogledalo ispred Dedeinog praznog akvarijuma, međutim, ribe borci ne podnose da vide druge ribe borce i mogu da postanu veoma nasilne i iskoče iz akvarijuma. Videvši svoj odraz, Dede je možda iskočila iz akvarijuma, ali gde je sada?

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Evropska mačka Kolačić, maskota staračkog doma i internet zvezda, nestala je pre tri dana. Alber i njegov unuk Merlen su veoma zabrinuti, Kolačić nikada nije nestajao na toliko dugo. Gledajući Kolačićeve snimke na internetu, Oskar je otkrio da mačka iz snimka u snimak gubi glas, baš kao i deka koji je takođe žrtva pokvarenog klima-uređaja... Ali kako da čuju mačku bez glasa?

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Garfildov neodoljivi neprijatelj Nermal ostaje kod Džona mesec dana. Garfild ne podnosi Nermalovu slatkoću. Ali Garfild ne zna da ga posmatraju. Na planeti Parma, vođa zna kako da dođe do Garfilda, svog zakletog neprijatelja, proždirača njegovog naroda _ lazanja. Garfildov ogroman apetit za lazanje je jedino što ga sprečava da napadne njegovu planetu. Stoga šalje špijuna prerušenog u još slađu verziju Nermala da uđe u Džonovu kuću i prikupi podatke o Garfildu. Ali uskoro će ""najslađa maca na svetu"" dobiti mnogo pažnje, čime neće biti zadovoljni ni Nermal, ni njegov vođa.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Džon vodi Garfilda i Odija na vakcine u Lizinu ordinaciju. Dok su tamo, upoznaju Princa Orlofa, izuzetno razmaženu mačku jednako razmažene i bogate Gospođe Van Gelt. Gospođa Van Gelt misli da nešto nije u redu sa Princom Orlofom, ali Liz je obaveštava da je njemu potrebno samo malo vežbe. Ta ideja zvuči sumanuto Gospođi Van Gelt koja smesta odlazi, ali Princu Orlofu to zvuči kao prava prilika da malo pobegne. On beži u Garfildovu i Odijevu kuću, gde ga Garfild i Odi uzimaju pod svoje okrilje, i pokazuju mu šta je to zabava. Ali Gospođu Van Gelt ništa neće sprečiti da ga vrati.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Braća Kret saznaju da su naučnici otkrili novu vrstu bogomoljke u amazonskoj prašumi u Peruu i nazvali je Liturgusa Kretorum, po njima. Odlučuju da krenu u pustolovinu sa ovim jedinstvenim insektom. Za to vreme, zlikovci Zak Varmitek, Donita Donata i kuvar Gurman su užasnuti što je bogomoljka nazvana po braći Kret umesto po njima, pa odlučuju da zarobe sve liturgose kretorum. Ekipa Kret mora da spasi bogomoljke i vrati ih u divljinu, da žive slobodno.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Ekipa Kret putuje u Kinu da ispita brojnost jedne od Avivinih omiljenih životinja: džinovske pande. Međutim, Zak Varmitek ima plan da uhvati pande i pretvori ih u robotske plišane igračke. Kad Zak otkrije da je ekipa Kret stigla u Kinu, njegovi Zakoboti će iscediti napajanje iz njihove tehnologije, ostavivši ekipu Kret zarobljenu u šumi bambusa. Da stvar bude gora, Zak hvata Martina, koji isprobava novo odelo sa moćima džinovske pande, zajedno sa pravim pandama. Ekipa Kret mora da koristi tajne varenja bambusa da bi pretvorila bambus u energiju kao džinovske pande, dobila panda-napajanje za svoju tehnologiju i spasila Martina i pande od Zaka.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Ekipa Kret čuje da su snežne sove primećene u oblastima prilično južno od njihovog uobičajenog staništa. Ekipa odlučuje da to istraži, ali nevolje počinju kada Donita Donata odluči da pravi kape od snežnih sova. Tada oni saznaju da je razlog ove pojave nedostatak plena na Arktiku tokom zime, zbog čega snežne sove lete na jug da bi došle do plena.

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad u kolevku
programme.desc: Nagon događaja u filmu Mali Šef 2, odraslom poslovnom čoveku Teodoru Templtonu smeštena je pronevera u kompaniji i primoran je da se vrati svom starom ja, Malom Šefu, i živi sa svojim bratom Timom. Ali da bi to izveo, mora da navede Timovu porodicu da mu dopusti da ostane, i ubedi Bebiko da mu vrati njegov stari posao... Koji trenutno obavlja njegova nećaka, beba Tina.

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad u kolevku
programme.desc: Nagon događaja u filmu Mali Šef 2, odraslom poslovnom čoveku Teodoru Templtonu smeštena je pronevera u kompaniji i primoran je da se vrati svom starom ja, Malom Šefu, i živi sa svojim bratom Timom. Ali da bi to izveo, mora da navede Timovu porodicu da mu dopusti da ostane, i ubedi Bebiko da mu vrati njegov stari posao... Koji trenutno obavlja njegova nećaka, beba Tina.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Zahvaljujući Garfildu i njegovoj nezasitosti, svim ljubimcima je zabranjen ulaz u Vitovu piceriju. Ali to ne znači da će Garfild prestati da pokušava! Džon i Liz su planirali romantičnu večeru kod Vita, a Garfild (zajedno sa Odijem) čvrsto odlučuje da uđe sa njima i proba svu Vitovu ukusnu hranu, čak i ako to znači da će morati da koristi sve moguće trikove i maske. Ali kada Džonov šef vidi to društvo i pomeša Garfilda i Odija sa Džonovim ćerkama, to može da košta Džona njegovog posla ili bi mogao da završi u neželjenom braku!

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Kritičar hrane Edi Gurman gubi posao voditelja sopstvene emisije, da bi ga zamenio urednik programa koji želi da ponudi zdraviji način kuvanja. Nakon slučajnog susreta u bioskopu, Džon ga poziva u svoju kuću na večeru. Ali kada Edi povredi stopalo zbog Garfilda, moraće da ostane kod Džona i naređuje mu da brine o njemu dok se ne oporavi, inače će ga tužiti. Ne samo što je Edi strašno zahtevan, već ima i jako veliki apetit (kao još neko koga poznajemo) i ubrzo svima zagorčava život. Ali Garfilda niko neće zaseniti u njegovom rođenom domu.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Pridružite se avanturama Krisa i Martina Kreta dok se susreću sa neverovatnim divljim životinjama, kombinujući naučno obrazovanje sa zabavom i avanturom, putujući do životinjskih staništa širom sveta. Svaka avantura istražuje život životinja i prikazuje do sada neviđen aspekt života u divljini. To je sve upakovano u zanimljivu priču o avanturi, misteriji, spasavanju i veoma zanimljivu komediju braće Kret od kakve ćete se grohotom smejati.

programme.title: Otvorena sezona - Zov prirode
programme.desc: Bug i Eliot se zbližavaju sa Dinom i njegovom bandom oposuma, uzbudljivim, ali sumnjivim likovima. Privučeni sjajem televizije, video igara i ukusne nezdrave hrane, ne primećuju šta se zaista dešava.

programme.title: Otvorena sezona - Zov prirode
programme.desc: Bug i Eliot se zbližavaju sa Dinom i njegovom bandom oposuma, uzbudljivim, ali sumnjivim likovima. Privučeni sjajem televizije, video igara i ukusne nezdrave hrane, ne primećuju šta se zaista dešava.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Pets klub ima zadatak da pronađe retkog i egzotičnog ljubimca: ženku kameleona. Ali nije lako doći do životinje koja ima naviku da se stapa sa okruženjem. Stvar postaje još hitnija kad naši junaci saznaju da će kameleon dobiti bebe! Za to vreme, Tim je vrlo zauzet jer Marlu mora da se vakciniše. Hoće li Pets klub uspeti da pronađe kameleona i vakciniše Marlua?

programme.title: Anderdog - Kuconja
programme.desc: Poli dobija mnogo žalbi. Kuconja svima uništava rođendane. Branioci otkrivaju da je Lošika kriva za to. Ona ima visokotehnološko odelo uz koje se predstavlja kao Kuconja. Baš kada branioci odluče da je se reše, shvatiće da se Lošika predstavlja kao jedna od njih!

programme.title: Anderdog - Kuconja
programme.desc: Mačkoslav želi da preuzme Štab branilaca! Da bi se rešio Poli, stavio je ogromnu raznobojnu slagalicu ispred gradske opštine. Kao veliki ljubitelj slagalica, Poli završava zarobljena u njoj. Branioci pokušavaju da joj pomognu, ali i oni završavaju zarobljeni. Dok pokušavaju da se spasu, Mačkoslav im govori da je slagalica u stvari svemirska raketa!

programme.title: Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Na diplomatskom putovanju u London, vladar kućnih ljubimaca iz grada Kaira postaje žrtva neobjašnjive krađe tokom posete Bakingamskoj palati.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Dečaci i devojke Veverice su obični klinci. Idu u školu, imaju kućne poslove i domaće zadatke, svađaju se kao porodica i nastupaju na rasprodatim koncertima pred milionima obožavalaca. O, jesmo li pomenuli da su oni međunarodne rok zvezde?

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Dečaci i devojke Veverice su obični klinci. Idu u školu, imaju kućne poslove i domaće zadatke, svađaju se kao porodica i nastupaju na rasprodatim koncertima pred milionima obožavalaca. O, jesmo li pomenuli da su oni međunarodne rok zvezde?

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Dečaci i devojke Veverice su obični klinci. Idu u školu, imaju kućne poslove i domaće zadatke, svađaju se kao porodica i nastupaju na rasprodatim koncertima pred milionima obožavalaca. O, jesmo li pomenuli da su oni međunarodne rok zvezde?

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Preminuo je dalji rođak porodice Arbakl, Ikabod, ostavljajući ogromno bogatstvo Džonu ili njegovom bratu Malom Doku pod jednim uslovom: moraće da provedu jednu noć u njegovoj vili pre nego što dobiju novac. Dosta lako, zar ne? Ali ne i kada saznaju da je vila ukleta! Garfild i Odi im pomažu, ali da li će Džon ili Mali Dok na kraju uspeti da pobede svoj strah i dočekati zoru u kući, a sa njom i svoju nagradu?

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Večeras Odi i Garfild gledaju film strave u dnevnoj sobi, a Džon pravi rođendansku tortu za Odija. Posvećen receptu koji mu sa ekrana diktira Edi Gurman, Džon shvata da mu nedostaje ključni sastojak. Govori Garfildu da nastavi da radi na torti dok ga on ne nađe, a Garfild unosi male izmene u recept. Čudovište koje na kraju izađe iz rerne ne izgleda više tako ""tortasto"" i na kraju ih juri po celom gradu, stvarajući paniku i rasulo. Spasavaj se ko može, stiže čudovišna torta! Srećom, Garfild ima plan da spasi sve i učini Odijev rođendan još uspešnijim.

programme.title: Kruds - Porodično Stablo
programme.desc: Ovo je nastavak priče o porodicama Kruds i Beterman koje uče da žive zajedno na najopuštenijoj farmi u praistoriji.

programme.title: Kruds - Porodično Stablo
programme.desc: Ovo je nastavak priče o porodicama Kruds i Beterman koje uče da žive zajedno na najopuštenijoj farmi u praistoriji.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Ekipa sapunice snima epizodu u Pom-le-Benu, sa Džoj Dijem kao posebnom gostujućom zvezdom. Producenti traže i dva sporedna lika: devojčicu i njenu baku! Sestre se svađaju oko toga koja od njih će spremati gospođu Žoržetu za audiciju. Svaka od njih ima svoju tehniku kojom će pretvoriti svoju komšinicu u glumicu. Ali hoće li gospođa Žoržeta biti spremna i uverljiva kad se suoči sa zombi gnomom?!

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Marina želi da vozi rolere sa sestrom, ali Vendi ima druge planove za danas. Hoće da gleda posebnu dvodelnu epizodu ""Vampirice"", svoje omiljene serije. Marina je razočarana i preti joj: ona je gledala seriju jutros i odaće joj potpuno neverovatan kraj, ako Vendi ne bude vozila rolere sa njom! Vendi ne popušta i odlazi da nađe savršeno skrovište na kom će gledati svoju seriju na miru... Ali Marina želi da vozi rolere i ništa je neće sprečiti u tome!

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: "Marina je nekako uverena da je ona princeza koju su usvojili njeni ""lažni roditelji"". Stvarno veruje u svoju priču i tera sve da ispunjavaju njene hirove. Vendi to ne podnosi i odlučuje da se ponaša prema Marini kao prema pravoj princezi, da bi joj to dosadilo jednom zauvek..."

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Vendi želi da proslavi svoj prvi suši sa Maksansom. Međutim, njena nesnosna mlađa sestra ih stalno prekida svojim izmišljenim razgovorima. ""Lule kaže ovo, Lule kaže ono..."" Vendi to više ne može da trpi! Sakriva mali zvučnik u igračku... Ovog puta će Lule progovoriti jasno i glasno!

programme.title: Živeti S Tatom
programme.desc: Dobrodošli u carstvo tatinih ćerki u kom žive polusestre Panda, Ondin, Roksana i beba Bela. Zavirite u nepredvidivu i razdraganu svakodnevnicu ove nekonvencionalne porodice. Ovaj porodični sitkom prosto morate da pogledate!

programme.title: Živeti S Tatom
programme.desc: Dobrodošli u carstvo tatinih ćerki u kom žive polusestre Panda, Ondin, Roksana i beba Bela. Zavirite u nepredvidivu i razdraganu svakodnevnicu ove nekonvencionalne porodice. Ovaj porodični sitkom prosto morate da pogledate!

programme.title: Nekada davno... Planeta Zemlja
programme.desc: Zbog globalnog zagrevanja, prolaz u Pacifiku preko ledenog lavirinta severa sada je slobodan! Pet susednih zemalja bori se za vlasništvo nad njim, a trebalo bi da se usredsredimo na ono što je zaista neophodno: smanjenje upotrebe fosilnih goriva za polovinu.

programme.title: Wake
programme.desc: When things get tough for offbeat Carys Reitman, she does what any emotionally isolated, modern girl would do _ she goes to strangers' funerals. At one fateful funeral, she unexpectedly meets Tyler, a man mourning his fiancée. Despite the warnings of her undertaker best friend Shane and her roommate Lila, she finds herself connecting to someone for the first time. Searching for answers, Carys goes to see her estranged mother to confront her past. And as she tries to open herself to the risks of love with Tyler, she realizes she may have more to fear than just a broken heart.

programme.title: Shaka Zulu: The Citadel
programme.desc: Prentice Mungo (David Hasselhoff) is a slave-trader who discovers that his ship is carrying a stowaway, Katherine (Karen Allen). Katherine is seeking passage to Africa to see her father, a British officer stationed there. But when they arrive, Mungo discovers Shaka, king of the Zulu tribe, among the slaves he is going to be transporting. Using his cleverness and leadership abilities, Zulu incites the slaves to revolt, and takes Katherine captive as he flees into the African countryside.

programme.title: Mayor Cupcake
programme.desc: A hard-working cupcake maker is inadvertently elected mayor of a small town burdened with debt. Uneducated, she relies on her street smarts to clean up the town.

programme.title: Wild Fire
programme.desc: Dream Town Development real estate bosses Jack Del Rio and Sy Richards can't convince animal lover Carol Tanner to sell and relocate safari/animal retirement ranch Wild Land, which she runs with younger sister Ballad since their parents died in a plane crash. Jack hires Bradshaw and Roach to release tiger Caesar, after that fails to cause a scandal to start a forest fire and release all animals, after tying up Carol. Ballad's lover, committed Glendora, southern California fire captain Kennedy, and his jumper team try their best to control the fire. Meanwhile young sheriff Drake Donovan and Ballad drug and catch wild animals. The arson is discovered, but the fiends aren't done yet.

programme.title: Fame
programme.desc: An updated version of the 1980 musical, which centered on the students of the New York Academy of Performing Arts.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
Area Q.
programme.desc: Thomas Mathews, an investigative journalist whose world is turned upside-down when his son disappears, is sent to Brazil to investigate close encounter sightings.

programme.title: El camino
programme.desc: Elliot, 31, a product of the Washington D.C. foster care system, has spent most of his life moving from place to place. When he is contacted by Matthew, a childhood friend from "the system" dying of cancer, Elliot goes to be by his side. At the funeral, he meets Gray and Lily, two friends of Matthew, both aimless in their present lives. Motivated by their sense of loss, and personal anger, Gray, Lily and Elliot steal Matthew's ashes and take them to Mexico. As the three travelers journey cross-country with Matthew's urn in tow, they are forced to confront their own sense of family, identity and future. Set against the changing American landscape, EL CAMINO follows these characters as they search for themselves in a country that has lost it's own identity. Gray, the wayward son of a prominent D.C. family, has left his pregnant girlfriend. He is angry, volatile and fearful of commitment. Lily is Matthew's ex-girlfriend. Unbeknownst to her parents, she has dropped out of college and become an exotic dancer. Lost in alcohol and pills she longs for her mother's approval. Elliot is outside the cultural mainstream. He carries a suitcase filled with documents and mementos of his life. An explorer of human experience, he interviews and videotapes people he meets. Haunted by dreams of his mother's drowning, Elliot struggles to find his place in the world. EL CAMINO is a humorous and compassionate film about friendship, family, and search for self in today's American landscape

programme.title: Running for Grace
programme.desc: A timeless story set in Hawaii in 1920s, about a young man who transcends the boundaries of race and class in search of forbidden love.

programme.title: Unexpected
programme.desc: Bob and Amy are at a crossroads: she wants to adopt a child, he doesn't. Will renovating their house and rescuing animals solve their problems? Will their new handyman and his son's pregnant girlfriend be the miracle they're looking for?...

programme.title: Riff Raff
programme.desc: Vincent is an ex-criminal who more than anything, just wants a normal, peaceful life. He and his wife Sandy, have built a loving family with their son DJ and are spending their last summer in a cabin before he goes off to college. Chaos ensues when Vincent's disowned son Rocco, his girlfriend Marina, and Vincent's ex-wife Ruth abruptly show up to spoil the festivities with an ominous warning: famed gangsters Leftie and Lonnie are coming for them.

programme.title: Barska svađa!
programme.desc: Nina i Alen nakon raskida dele sve što su zajedno stekli u životu, ali ih očekuje urnebesna borba za vlasništvo nad njihovim dragocenim pabom. U ovoj borbi povlači se crta, bira se strana i počinje ludo takmičenje u ispijanju piva.

programme.title: Igra u četvoro
programme.desc: Kerol (Alis Taljoni), ilustratorka knjiga za decu, ugovara pregled kod ginekologa. Pokazuje se da je ginekolog poznanik Lajonel (Fransoa Kluzet). Kerol i Lajonel tokom tog pregleda slučajno otkrivaju da njihove partnere veže ljubavnički odnos. Oboje žele da spasu svoje veze. Zato se dogovaraju da će učiniti sve kako bi povratili svoje partnere. Kako bi ostvarili cilj koriste se različitim metodima i načinima, često smešnim. Uskoro nešto dublje počinje povezivati Kerol i Lajonela. Osveta je slatka.

programme.title: Kosti moje sestre
programme.desc: Posle iznenadne smrti majke, ratna dopisnica Kejt Rafter vraća se iz Iraka u porodičnu kuću u Hern Beju. Tamo je čekaju otuđena sestra i mračna porodična tajna. Suočavanje s prošlošću u njoj budi sumnju da se u mirnom primorskom mestu krije nešto zlokobno.

programme.title: Nedozvoljeno
programme.desc: Kada oboje podlegnu iskušenjima "sa strane", bračni par shvata da je ulazak u vanbračnu vezu daleko jednostavniji nego pokušaj da se iz nje izađe.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Istina o lažima
programme.desc: Gilbi se zatiče u zamršenoj mreži laži, jer je istinu preteško priznati, a još teže prihvatiti.

programme.title: Olimpijski snovi
programme.desc: U Olimpijskom selu sportista mlada skijašica se zbližava sa volonterom dok se završava njen takmičarski nastup.

programme.title: Skoro prijatelji
programme.desc: Čarli, neambiciozni muškarac u srednjim dvadesetim godinama koji i dalje živi s majkom i očuhom i zaljubljuje se u mladu ženu koja je u vezi s ozbiljnim muškarcem.

programme.title: Mala sirena
programme.desc: Mladi novinar i njegova sestričina otkrivaju prelepo i očaravajuće stvorenje za koje veruju da je prava mala sirena.

programme.title: Deset stvari koje bi trebalo da uradimo pre raskida
programme.desc: Kada Ebigejl, samohrana majka dvoje dece, zatrudni nakon jedne noći provedene s Benom, ovaj neobični par pokušaće da se izbori s novonastalom situacijom.

programme.title: Disko
programme.desc: Didje je četrdesetogodišnjak _ fan disko muzike. Muškarac nema posla i još uvek živi sa majkom. Didje ima sina, kojeg dugo nije video, ipak njegova majka ne slaže se da zajedno provedu odmor. Didje odlučuje da pobedi u plesnom konkursu, da dobije nagradu i da povede sina na nezaboravni odmor u Australiju. Muškarac nagovara svoje prijatelje da mu pomognu. Zapošljavaju trenera, koji treba da ih pripremi za takmičenje. Brzo se uspostavlja, da makar nekad bili su odlični plesači, vreme je uradilo svoje. Moraju puno da rade da bi nastupili.

programme.title: Izviđačka avantura
programme.desc: Film o odrastanju grupe dečaka i devojčica, koji se vraćaju s kampovanja i shvataju da je njihov mali grad pod opsadom grupe prilično tupavih bajkera. Koristeći svoje izviđačko znanje, deca savladavaju članove bande, jednog po jednog.

programme.title: Poslednji ples
programme.desc: Nakon tragedije, poznata plesna kompanija iz Njujorka nalazi se na ivici kolapsa. Iako su napustili svet plesa zauvek, Travis, Krisa i Maks imaju poslednju šansu da ponovo pronađu strast i dokažu da čuda zaista mogu da se dogode.

programme.title: Mala roze kuća
programme.desc: Žena se bori protiv grupe koja pokušava da iseli ceo njen kraj i preda ga korporaciji. S malom prednošću u broju glasova, Vrhovni sud donosi presudu u korist korporacije, koja sada, na mestu njenog srušenog doma, uopšte ne namerava da započne izgradnju.

programme.title: Nestala
programme.desc: Kad njena sestra nestane, Džil je ubeđena da se vratio serijski ubica koji ju je kidnapovao pre dve godine. Spremna je da se još jednom suoči s čovekom koji ju je oteo.

programme.title: Šta učini, sine moj?
programme.desc: Inspirisan zločinom koji se dogodio, čovek počinje da doživljava stvari koje će ga navesti da mačem ubije rođenu majku.

programme.title: London boulevard
programme.desc: Priča o londonskom kriminalcu koji izlazi iz zatvora i započinje vezu s mladom povučenom glumicom.

programme.title: London boulevard
programme.desc: Priča o londonskom kriminalcu koji izlazi iz zatvora i započinje vezu s mladom povučenom glumicom.

programme.title: Dobar komšija
programme.desc: Dvojica nestašnih srednjoškolaca uspešno uveravaju svog vremešnog komšiju da u njegovoj kući ima duhova. Međutim, niz nesrećnih okolnosti pretvara njihovu bezazlenu šalu u tragediju.

programme.title: Devojka broj jedan
programme.desc: Producent, režiser i akciona zvezda; to je sve što vam je potrebno da snimite najbolji film svih vremena. Zar ne?

programme.title: Pad Kandahara
programme.desc: 1999 godina, britanski miner koji radi za Talibane u Avganistanu, mora da beži, kad je uvučen u smrtonosnu igru, zaveru i izdaju.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Vidimo se u septembru
programme.desc: "Vidimo se u septembru" je originalna romantična komedija, smeštena u moderni Menhetn. Film govori o Lizi, prelepoj ženi koja naizgled ima sve, ali se duboko u sebi plaši vezivanja. Kad sazna da će njen terapeut celog avgusta biti na odmoru, šokirana je i uplašena. Umesto da ovu vest prihvati smireno, ona traži pomoć od ogorčene prijateljice, Monike.

programme.title: Čekanje na sreću
programme.desc: Ko kaže da morate da pobedite da biste postali šampion? Slava Kolotilof, učitelj iz mirnog primorskog gradića Fingers, kreće u osvajanje Moskve, s originalnim rukopisom svog prvog romana. Umesto toga, sasvim nenadano, osvaja srce lepotice Nađe, koju glumi Mila Jovović. Venčanje se bliži i Slava mora da napusti posao i pozdravi se sa Fingersom, pre povratka u Moskvu i početka novog života sa svojom nevestom. Ali, zbog spleta bizarnih okolnosti, ne može da se vrati u veliki grad. Venčanje će se održati bez obzira na sve, a Nađa mora da se odbrani od napada bivšeg dečka Danje, koji je na sve spreman kako bi je vratio.

programme.title: Kamp snova
programme.desc: Devojka koja nema mnogo dodirnih tačaka sa sportom, Vitni Karmajkl, prijavljuje se u fizički veoma zahtevan letnji kamp kako bi unela promene u svoj život, ali se tamo zaljubljuje u svog trenera. Na svom putovanju pronalazi snagu da prihvati sebe onakvu kakva jeste i da se oslobodi tuđih očekivanja.

programme.title: Zen noar
programme.desc: Neimenovani "noir" detektiv, koji još uvek oplakuje gubitak svoje supruge, istražuje tajanstvenu smrt u budističkom hramu, ali su njegove veštine i logički pristup rešavanju zločina potpuno beskorisni u intuitivnom, nelinearnom svetu žena.

programme.title: Raskinuli smo
programme.desc: Dugogodišnji partneri Lori i Dag raskidaju samo nekoliko dana pre venčanja Lorine mlađe sestre Bi i Džejsona. Da ne bi pokvarili slavlje, odlučuju da se pretvaraju da su i dalje zajedno dok vikend ne prođe.

programme.title: Priča o Džejn Ostin
programme.desc: Biografski portret mlade Džejn Ostin pre slave i romanse s mladim Ircem.

programme.title: Poslednja potera
programme.desc: Godine 1909, Vili Boj i njegova voljena Karlota beže nakon što on u kobnom sukobu slučajno usmrti njenog oca. Dok se predsednik Taft sprema da poseti ovu oblast, lokalni šerif i dvojica indijanskih tragača kreću u poteru za čovekom kog smatraju ubicom svog plemenskog vođe.

programme.title: Poslednja stvar
programme.desc: Dilan Derindžer, usamljeni stomatolog sa Floride, suočava se s osobom iz prošlosti koja mu donosi vesti koje ga vode na uzbudljivo putovanje. Na ovom putovanju otkriće sebe i promeniti sopstveni život.

programme.title: Draga Elizabet
programme.desc: Muškarac koji vodi dosadan život slučajno počinje da proganja staru koleginicu s fakulteta, glumicu Elizabet Benks, na društvenim mrežama. U svojim pokušajima da dokaže da je poznaje, ponovo otkriva sebe i pravo značenje prijateljstva.

programme.title: Nikad neću biti tvoja
programme.desc: Majka započinje vezu s mlađim muškarcem, dok se njena ćerka prvi put zaljubljuje. Ipak, sudbina će tu umešati prste i poigrati se njihovim životima.

programme.title: Poslednji dah
programme.desc: Grupa starih prijatelja sa fakulteta ponovo se okuplja na ronilačkom izletu u Karibima, istražujući olupinu ratnog broda iz Drugog svetskog rata. Međutim, ubrzo će biti zarobljeni u podvodnom lavirintu od zarđalog metala, okruženi velikim belim ajkulama.

programme.title: Ona je kriminalac
programme.desc: Sju Parker gurnuta je u očajničku borbu da spase porodični posao koji se, zbog nemara njenog oca, nalazi na ivici propasti. Dolaskom šarmantnog skitnice, ona prepoznaje jedinu nadu da spreči da njihov bar padne u ruke nemilosrdnog lokalnog tajkuna.

programme.title: Hitler: Beast of Berlin
programme.desc: Hans Memling, a young intellectual, patriotic German, is secretly opposed to the Nazi regime. With the aid of Gustav Schultz, Father Pommer, Anna Wahl and others, he is gleaning accurate information from foreign radio broadcasts and distributing it through Germany with an underground-press operation.

programme.title: Au service du diable
programme.desc: A group of tourists traveling on a bus take a detour to stay overnight in a castle owned by a family cursed with a history of Satanism and death.

programme.title: Hit and Run
programme.desc: When an only child is struck by a car and dies, the child's mother seeks vengeance against the driver in this thrilling drama. The car was driven by the wife of a company president who is having an affair. The woman's husband manages to buy silence about the incident, but the victim's mother discovers the identity of the driver. After she secures a job in the home of the company president and his philandering spouse, the woman plans to murder the couple's son when he reaches the age of her late son.

programme.title: Vigilantes
programme.desc: Young Mary settles in a town to follow theater courses. Just after her arrival, she is sexually assaulted. The next day she meets Eve, a non-conformist young woman with frayed nerves, who drags her along in a nocturnal and violent maze. For the space of one night, they become Les Vigilantes.

programme.title: The Nest
programme.desc: Cora, a 19-year-old girl, has recently returned to the place where she spent her childhood, Bucco. The arrival of the mysterious Saverio gradually upsets the harmony of the "holy" place, unearthing a crime committed by the villagers 40 years before.

programme.title: The Harvest
programme.desc: Thousands of foreign workers support today the most known Italian excellence: agri-food production. A docu-musical shows their daily exploitation.

programme.title: Life with Father
programme.desc: A financier from New York rules his numerous family, consisting of his wife and his four sons, with the meticulousness of a bookkeeper.

programme.title: Went the Day Well?
programme.desc: The quiet village of Bramley End is taken over by German troops posing as Royal Engineers. Their task is to disrupt England's radar network in preparation for a full scale German invasion. Once the villagers discover the true identity of the troops, they do whatever they can to thwart the Nazis plans.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: Terror by Night
programme.desc: Holmes and Watson board a passenger train bound from London to Edinburgh, to guard the Star of Rhodesia, an enormous diamond worth a fortune belonging to an elderly woman of wealth; but within the first hour of the trip, the woman's son is murdered and the diamond stolen and any of the passengers in their car could be the killer thief.

programme.title: Autumn Has Already Started
programme.desc: A single mother from the country raising a 6th grade boy comes to Tokyo, leaves the boy to live with his uncle's family, runs a struggling grocery store, and works a local inn. The boy befriends a girl, the daughter of the innkeeper.

programme.title: The Murder in the Museum
programme.desc: When a city councilman is murdered while investigating allegations of drug dealing going on a a somewhat disreputable sideshow, the daughter of the chief suspect teams up with a newspaper reporter to find the real killer.

programme.title: Arima
programme.desc: ARIMA It is the story of four women and a girl who- se existence is disrupted by the sudden arrival of two strangers. One of them is fleeing from the other, sneaking around town like an elusive being, a ghostly presence of uncertain existence. The other character --an injured man carrying a gun-- will disrupt the women's way of life in different ways. The whole plot takes place on the fine line between reality and imagination, between dreams and nightmares, fear and desire, within a story shrouded in mystery ARIMA is something you glimpse through the mist, something you can sense but still fail to see clearly. A dream, a memory, a desire.

programme.title: Sixty Glorious Years
programme.desc: Picking up where Victoria the Great (1937) left off, this sequel to the 1937 film has Anna Neagle return to the role of Queen Victoria in another colorful account of the revered British monarch's reign.

programme.title: Bela Lugosi Meets a Brooklyn Gorilla
programme.desc: Two goofy entertainers meet a mad scientist on a jungle island.

programme.title: Father
programme.desc: Mourning the death of her father, Giulia is contacted by him from the other dimension.

programme.title: The Tune of the Wind
programme.desc: An 8 year old Bolivian boy gets lost on the streets of La Paz, hundreds of kilometers from home. He survives many challenges before he sets out in an emotive journey to find his lost father.

programme.title: Jack London
programme.desc: Episodes in adventurous life of the American novelist.

programme.title: Love Laughs at Andy Hardy
programme.desc: Andy Hardy goes to college after serving in the war and finds his sweetheart is engaged to someone else.

programme.title: The Passionate Plumber
programme.desc: Paris plumber Elmer Tuttle is enlisted by socialite Patricia Alden to help make her lover Tony Lagorce jealous. With the help of his friend Julius J. McCracken and through the high society contacts he has made through Patricia, Elmer hopes to find financing for his latest invention, a pistol with a range-finding light. Comic complications ensue when Elmer's effort to interest a military leader is misconstrued as an assassination attempt.

programme.title: The Mysterious Mr. Wong
programme.desc: Mr. Wong is a "harmless" Chinatown shopkeeper by day and relentless blood-thirsty pursuer of the Twelve Coins of Confucius by night. With possession of the coins, Mr. Wong will be supreme ruler of the Chinese province of Keelat, and his evil destiny will be fulfilled. A killing spree follows in dark and dangerous Chinatown as Wong gets control of 11 of the 12 coins. Reporter Jason Barton and his girl Peg are hot on his trail, but soon find themselves in serious trouble when they stumble onto Wong's headquarters.

programme.title: The Phantom of 42nd Street
programme.desc: A theatre critic (Dave O'Brien) teams up with a cop (Jack Mulhall) to investigate the murder of a Broadway actor.

programme.title: Doctor Blood's Coffin
programme.desc: Greta is a beautiful young woman abused by her brother Franz and left to die in childbirth by her illicit lover, the aristocrat Dr. von Ravensbrück. Bereft with grief, Franz reanimates his dead sister using a formula engraved on an ancient Incan medallion. Greta then returns as an undead avenging angel, reaping revenge on the Ravensbrück family and her manically possessive brother.

programme.title: Please Murder Me
programme.desc: A lawyer tries to exact justice on a woman he defended in court -- a woman whom he found out was guilty after getting her off.

programme.title: Indiscreet
programme.desc: A young woman jeopardizes the relationship with the man she loves when a no-account from her past shows up.

programme.title: Scarlet Street
programme.desc: A banned box-office hit, Scarlet Street is one of Fritz Lang's greatest American films. Middle-aged cashier Chris Cross rescues streetwise Kitty and tumbles into a spiral of desire, deception, and revenge. As his obsession grows, Chris is seduced, degraded, and transformed, while fate delivers a grimly ironic justice. Featuring standout performances by Joan Bennett and Dan Duryea, the film is packed with sharp twists and masterful direction—a classic, pitch-dark gem of film noir.

programme.title: Behave Yourself
programme.desc: When a cute Welsh terrier follows Bill Denny home, little does he know that all gangland has its eye on that dog.

programme.title: Following Nazarin
programme.desc: A journey through memory accompanied by Buñuel's photographs taken during the scouting of locations for "Nazarín", as well as the ones made by Manuel Álvarez Bravo during the shooting of the film, along with the testimonies and reflections of artists, filmmakers and intellectuals like Luis Eduardo Aute, Jean Claude Carrière, Carlos Reygadas, Silvia Pinal, Arturo Ripsetein or Carlos Saura among many others, to re-discover the poetic, vivid and inspiring force of Buñuel's cinematography.

programme.title: The Lady Refuses
programme.desc: A wealthy London nobleman hires a pretty but poor young woman to distract his playboy son from marrying a golddigger. Complications ensue when the girl and the father begin to fall for each other, and things get even more complicated when the son declares his love for her, too.

programme.title: When a Dream Comes True
programme.desc: Ed decides to leave his life in Barcelona to take a trip to the United States to follow his childhood dream of becoming a filmmaker there. Close to turning 40, and with his wedding just around the corner, he realizes that his life has not worked out as he had planned. An identity crisis begins which makes him leave everything and try to make his childhood dream —the American dream— come true. With the script of a film he wrote a few years ago under his arm, and the idea of trying to make the project a reality in the United States, Ed embarks on a road trip from New York to Hollywood, on which he meets diverse characters with whom he reflects upon the pros and cons of following our dreams, while at the same time he tries to achieve his and seeks a more precise definition of happiness.

programme.title: The Monster Maker
programme.desc: Mad scientist injects his enemies with acromegaly virus, causing them to become hideously deformed.

programme.title: Africa Screams
programme.desc: When bookseller Buzz cons Diana into thinking that his friend Stanley knows all there is to know about Africa, they are abducted and ordered to lead Diana and her henchmen to an African tribe in search of a fortune in jewels.

programme.title: Renegade Girl
programme.desc: Ann Shelby, whose family is allied with the notorious William Quantrill, turns outlaw to revenge herself on a renegade Indian who killed her brother.

programme.title: Pot o' Gold
programme.desc: Jimmy goes to work with his uncle, the owner of a food factory. Before he gets there, he befriends an Irish family who happens to be his uncle's worst enemy because of their love for music and in-house band who constantly practices.

programme.title: King of the Zombies
programme.desc: During World War II, a small plane somewhere over the Caribbean runs low on fuel and is blown off course by a storm. Guided by a faint radio signal, they crash-land on an island. The passenger, his manservant and the pilot take refuge in a mansion owned by a doctor. The quick-witted yet easily-frightened manservant soon becomes convinced the mansion is haunted by zombies and ghosts.

programme.title: College
programme.desc: Ronald's high-school valedictory address praises books and condemns sports. His girlfriend Mary condemns his attitude. Fearing to lose her to rival Jeff, he decides to go to college and pay more attentions to sports.

programme.title: Doll Face
programme.desc: Burlesque queen Doll Face Carroll is dismissed from an audition for a legitimate Broadway show because she lacks culture. Her boss/manager Mike decides that she can get both culture and plenty of publicity by writing her autobiography. He hires a ghost writer to do all the work, but doesn't count on the possibility that Doll Face and her collaborator might have more than a book on their minds.

programme.title: Trapped
programme.desc: Secret Service agents make a deal with a counterfeiting inmate to be released on early parole if he will help them recover some bogus moneymaking plates, but he plans to double cross them.

programme.title: The Smallest Show on Earth
programme.desc: Jean and Bill are a married couple trying to scrape a living. Out of the blue they receive a telegram informing them Bill's long-lost uncle has died and left them his business—a cinema in the town of Sloughborough. Unfortunately they can't sell it for the fortune they hoped as they discover it is falling down and almost worthless.

programme.title: Đavolja posla: Smrtonosna ljubav
programme.desc: Tri muškarca umiru u periodu od 12 godina, bez sumnje da je u pitanju zločin. Ali kada smrtonosna eksplozija automobila odjekne u Pensakoli na Floridi, započinje nova istraga.

programme.desc: Pratite bivšeg šefa španskog fudbalskog saveza Luisa Rubijalesa tokom suđenja zbog kontraverznog poljupca na Svetskom prvenstvu za žene.

programme.title: Klinika za kožne probleme

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Plastic, once accidental, is now essential—from machines to daily items. It began with explosive billiard balls and beetle poop, leading to Bakelite and later nylon. Nylon's popularity even sparked riots during WWII. But plastic's durability and oil-based origin raise environmental concerns. Now, bioplastics grown in microorganisms—and possibly plants—offer quirky, sustainable alternatives for the future.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. programme.title: Infestation
programme.desc: Our cities are being attacked, overrun and overwhelmed with pests and invasive species bent on decimating our homes and threatening our well being. What happens if these urban invaders continue to expand their territory and occupy our safe haven? Is it just a matter of time before an emerging deadly disease carried by one of those urban invaders creates havoc in our big cities?

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: In this episode, we face the wild winds—hurricanes, cyclones, tornadoes, twisters, and typhoons. These powerful storms differ in form: hurricanes grow over warm oceans and can span 600 miles, while tornadoes are spinning air tubes touching ground and clouds, reaching speeds of 200 mph. They can destroy buildings, uproot trees, and hurl vehicles like toys. A tornado's path may stretch over a mile wide and 50 miles long. The U.S. sees about 1,000 tornadoes yearly—2% violent enough to wreak havoc.

programme.title: RV Explorers
programme.desc: RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ _ experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: The team head to Tutbury Castle in Derbyshire to investigate the paranormal reports at the location. Past Hunters appear to have caught the Tutbury Ghost on camera.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears journeys into the remote wilderness region of Arnhem land to the Cooper Creek Billabong. He's there during the dry season and all the wild life is concentrated into a narrow stretch of water. He comes face to face with the dominant saltwater crocodile and watches as the croc manoeuvres a dead pig down river to a secret hiding place. Ray travels into Stone Country above the Billabong where he finds a gallery of ancient Aboriginal art and joins locals Connie Nayinggul and her grandson Moses on a fishing expedition. They catch a barramundi and cook the fish in a traditional ground oven using paper bark.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Posse the red panda and Santiago the saki have been having issues with their teeth. The dentist has arrived but he's got some good news and bad news. The good news is neither of them have to foot the bill. The bad news is, he's brought his big pliers! Ever heard the tale of how the blue throated macaw parrot was saved from extinction and started a new fashion trend in the process? Loro Parque reports from the Bolivian front line and the front row of the local fashion parade!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: For over a year, the staff at Loro Parque have been patiently waiting for a huge event to take place. Morgan, the deaf orca is about to give birth to her very first calf. The stakes are high, and the staff are holding their collective breath as the scene is set for the greatest natural phenomenon in the zoo's history.

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Fanged Spiders with their scurrying bites. The Scorpion with its deadly sting... A sinister cold bloodied crocodile. The hypnotizing venomous snake. Or the King of Beasts, the Lion? Which one is the most dangerous? Lion _ With golden fur and regal mane, the lion reigns as the 'King of Beasts'. Scorpions _ In scorched deserts, danger awakens after sunset. Spiders _ Masters of webs and venom, spiders haunt myth and imagination. Snakes _ Feared and revered, snakes symbolize power, death, and rebirth. Crocodile _ Ancient and deadly, crocodiles inspire fear and legend across the globe.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The charming kangaroo. The cuddly koala. The beautiful Butterfly. The cheerful clown fish. Or the endearing budgerigar _ which is the cutest of them all? Clownfish _ Tropical oceans shimmer with dazzling marine life like the vibrant clownfish. Kangaroo _ Australia's countryside pulses with thousands of bounding kangaroos. Monarch Butterfly _ Monarchs fill the skies, delicate and stunning in flight. Budgerigar _ Social and lively, wild budgies flock in hundreds across Australia. Koala _ Soft-furred and beloved, koalas are one of Australia's most iconic animals.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Sharks are BIG business in adrenaline eco-tourism. And some thrill seekers deliberately pursue close encounters with deadly sharks _ without the protection of a cage. The bigger and more dangerous the shark, the better. Shark advocates Dr. Erich Ritter and Chuck Anderson have grave reservations about how far we are willing to go for a thrill. And they have intimate knowledge of the subject. Both men were brutally attacked by bull sharks. Shark Divers also examines the controversy surrounding a handful of high-profile attacks in 2008, including the first shark tourist killed while on a shark excursion.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Predators use speed, teeth, poison, and trickery to survive, but prey animals have evolved fascinating defenses. While fleeing is common, others use deception and chemistry—camouflage, mimicry, and toxins. Insects mimic leaves, snakes play dead, fish fly, and toads have poisonous skin. Predator-prey dynamics form an evolutionary arms race, with each side adapting to outsmart the other. Defense mechanisms include claws, poison, camouflage, and foul sprays. From zebra patterns to spider silk, strong defenses are vital to winning the Race of Life.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Most sea creatures are predators, from tiny fish to giant squid. Built to hunt and survive, they've evolved into efficient underwater war machines. Stonefish lie in wait, disguised, while sharks, barracuda, and moray eels hunt with speed and precision. Reef fish must dodge lightning-fast barracuda and graceful but deadly moray eels. Lionfish use venomous spines, and stonefish can swallow prey whole. In the ocean's depths, survival is a constant battle—an underwater jungle of razor teeth and stealthy ambushes.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan heads down to the shipwrecks of North Carolina (USA) to observe how these wrecks have become home to thousands of animals, including Sand Tiger sharks. But instead of chasing all the fish, the sharks are protecting many of them! Then, Jonathan visits the School for Field Studies in the Turks & Caicos Islands to learn how college students conduct fieldwork in their pursuit of degrees in Marine Studies. He helps tag sharks, study conch and investigate marine protected areas!

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In a shark-filled adventure, Jonathan travels to the Bahamas to meet Neal Harvey, a world-renown shark handler who will attempt to teach Jonathan how to put Caribbean Reef sharks into a relaxed state known as tonic immobility! Then, Jonathan heads to NASA's Neutral Buoyancy Lab in Houston, Texas (USA), where astronauts train for space walking underwater, in a giant pool about half the size of a soccer field. Jonathan gets a rare and fascinating look into this high-tech diving as he ventures underwater with the astronauts.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Canned food began with Napoleon's contest to preserve food, won by Appert's boiled, sealed bottles. The British later developed metal cans, though early ones exploded or caused illness. Can openers came 30 years later. Pasteur's germ theory explained spoilage. Pressure-cooking improved taste, and now, 'raddaperization'—zapping food—is the future. Canning evolved from battlefield necessity to high-tech preservation.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Medical history is full of odd cures—like bloodletting, which still helps in rare cases. Germs were once doubted until a doctor spotted bacteria between his teeth. Fleming later discovered antibiotics by accident. But now, "superbugs" threaten this miracle cure. Refrigeration, once deadly due to toxic gases, evolved thanks to pressure-cooking and may soon use sound waves. From leeches to lab breakthroughs, medicine keeps evolving—what's next?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's cheesy and and eaten all over the world! You'll learn how Dominick's pizza became Domino's pizza. And we all know how going to a circus wouldn't be complete without fluffy sweet cotton candy! We'll explain how this feathery goodness Spun to life! And all the spy action heroes use them, but where did the term gadget really come from?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Take a trip to the Jersey Shore and learn how one of its famous boardwalks helped to inspire the iconic board game of Monopoly. And how did a donkey and an elephant become associated with politics? Plus, what's the difference between top grain leather and full grain leather?

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our Solar System four and half billion years ago there remains tantalizing clues to its evolution; remnent debris: asteroids and comets. They vary in size from grains of dust to mountain sides, footballs to planetoids. They were the building blocks of the planets and perhaps carry the origins of life itself. Now within our grasp these rocks of ice and dust are ready to give up their secrets.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Beyond the asteroid belt lay the ice giants, some can be seen with the naked eye, others only glimpsed once by a passing probe. We are again sending cameras to the edge of the solar system giving us new insights into the evolution of our worlds.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Animation creates motion from still images shown in rapid sequence. Aviation illusions affect pilots' balance due to conflicting sensory input. The spinning dancer illusion shows bistable perception—viewers may see it spin in either direction. Mirages occur when light bends through layers of air at different temperatures. Rainbows form when sunlight refracts and reflects through water droplets, splitting light into visible colors.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Iridescence causes surfaces to reflect shifting colors due to light interference. Chemiluminescence produces light via chemical reactions, while bioluminescence does the same in living organisms using luciferin and luciferase. Gemstone colors come from structural elements or impurities affecting light absorption. Mechanical plant defenses include thorns, spines, and microscopic features that help plants survive threats.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial _ a predator _ that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia _ a Tiger Quoll _ smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

From tending to oversexed otters, fine-footed flamingoes or armoured armadillos, a day spent with Jorge, is a day immersed in nature from the four corners of the globe. Ever seen a grown man hug a turtle? For Javier, Loro Parque's Head of Environmental Affairs, it's all part of the job! He's hitting the high seas of Tenerife with a turtle tracker in hand to help with scientific research _ but first he's just got to locate the turtle _ 2,000 meters down in the ocean!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: "Finding Nemo" may have brought fame to the striped clownfish but their newfound popularity has sent worldwide numbers into decline. Now we follow the aquarium team as they initiate their very own breeding program with the hope of finding many more Nemos to come. Jorge has got a 200-pound problem on his hands. Lin Mao the white tiger has something wrong with his hip and the vets need to make a diagnosis. Problem is, Lin Mao's not responding to the anesthetic Jorge just administered and he has to decide what to do next...very quickly.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The legendary wild dingo, the iconic kangaroos, vicious feral cats, the delightfully bizarre platypus and the unmistakably cuddly koala _ all call Australia home. Koala _ Hidden high in gum trees, the koala is one of Australia's most beloved animals. Dingo _ Sleek, agile, and descended from wolves, dingoes are Australia's top land carnivores. Kangaroo _ With powerful legs and iconic bounds, kangaroos embody the spirit of Australia. Wild Cats _ Over 12 million wild house cats roam Australia's diverse landscapes. Platypus _ Unique and mysterious, the platypus is one of Australia's most enchanting creatures.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Radar accurate eyes survey the land, slotted feathers adjust flight paths as falcons attack, pelicans soar, kestrels hover, owls silently fly, parrots flock, vultures swarm and eagles swoop. Which is the true Master of the Sky? Peregrine Falcon _ Revered for speed and power, this raptor was favored by ancient falconers. Budgie _ Bright green and yellow budgies light up Australia's skies in lively flocks. Wedge-tailed Eagle _ Australia's largest bird of prey commands awe with its soaring presence. Pelican _ Graceful giants of the sky, pelicans glide in formation on rising thermals. Seabirds _ Nearly 300 species live between sea and air, truly free in their vast domain. Barn Owl _ Mysterious and wise, the barn owl watches silently from the shadows. Vulture _ Africa's plains are scanned by vultures, nature's cleanup crew. Nankeen Kestrel _ Australia's smallest falcon, elegant and inquisitive, glides over open land.

programme.title: The Blue Realm
programme.desc: The tiny island nation of Tonga in the remote South Pacific is a haven for the magnificent mammals. With few natural resources or other means of income, the country is considering opening it's waters to foreign whaling fleets in exchange for hard currency. The merits and legitimacy of scientific whaling by Japan and other nations is hotly debated. The iconic species is a favorite of whale watchers from Alaska to Mexico and the stage is set for an epic battle between whalers and conservationists. Humpbacks: From Tonga to Antarctica also features Paul Watson of the Sea Shepherd Society.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: The ocean is a harsh world where survival depends on feeding and avoiding predators. Sea creatures use camouflage, bright colors, venom, and group behavior for protection. Some hide, others rely on safety in numbers. Even venomous animals must stay alert. From top predators to bottom feeders, each species has evolved unique strategies. Defense includes toxins, teeth, mimicry, and camouflage. Nudibranchs, clownfish, squid, octopus, and orcas are just a few winners in the underwater Race of Life, adapting brilliantly to their environment.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Insects may be small, but their survival strategies are fierce. They thrive in diverse environments thanks to their exoskeletons, which protect against impact, chemicals, and water. Wings help them escape danger or seek food and mates. Dragonflies hover and dart after prey, monarchs undergo stunning metamorphosis, and praying mantises blend into greenery before striking. Social insects like ants and bees live in colonies. From camouflage to flight, every adaptation helps insects stay in the Race of Life.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim
